content_source_alignments_check.name: content_source_alignments_check

diagnostic_items_level_present_check.name: diagnostic_items_level_present_check
diagnostic_items_level_present_check.value: grade_level_id IS NOT NULL OR proficiency_level_id IS NOT NULL

exam_papers_level_present_check.name: exam_papers_level_present_check
exam_papers_level_present_check.value: exam_kind = 'DIAGNOSTIC' OR grade_level_id IS NOT NULL OR proficiency_level_id IS NOT NULL

exam_papers_pass_percent_check.name: exam_papers_pass_percent_check
exam_papers_pass_percent_check.value: pass_percent IS NULL OR (pass_percent >= (0)::numeric AND pass_percent <= (100)::numeric)

source_materials_planning_period_count_c.name: source_materials_planning_period_count_check
source_materials_planning_period_count_c.value: planning_period_count IS NULL OR planning_period_count BETWEEN 1 AND 12

source_outline_nodes_planning_period_no_.name: source_outline_nodes_planning_period_no_check
source_outline_nodes_planning_period_no_.value: planning_period_no IS NULL OR planning_period_no BETWEEN 1 AND 12

source_outline_nodes_check1.name: source_outline_nodes_check1
source_outline_nodes_check1.value: (page_from IS NULL) OR (page_to IS NULL) OR (page_from <= page_to)

teachers_service_since_check.name: teachers_service_since_check
teachers_service_since_check.value: service_since IS NULL OR service_since >= DATE '1950-01-01'

attendance_marks_participation_check.name: attendance_marks_participation_check
attendance_marks_participation_check.value: participation IS NULL OR participation IN ('HIGH', 'GOOD', 'WATCH')

class_schedule_not_held_reason_check.name: class_schedule_not_held_reason_check
class_schedule_not_held_reason_check.value: held OR not_held_reason IS NOT NULL

class_schedule_quiz_question_count_check.name: class_schedule_quiz_question_count_check
class_schedule_quiz_question_count_check.value: quiz_question_count IS NULL OR quiz_question_count BETWEEN 1 AND 50

class_schedule_quiz_attempts_check.name: class_schedule_quiz_attempts_check
class_schedule_quiz_attempts_check.value: quiz_attempts IS NULL OR quiz_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 10

class_schedule_page_range_check.name: class_schedule_page_range_check

homework_due_check.name: homework_due_check
homework_due_check.value: due_on IS NULL OR due_on >= assigned_on

study_plan_days_score_check.name: study_plan_days_score_check
study_plan_days_score_check.value: score IS NULL OR (score >= 0 AND score <= 100)

timetable_slots_range_check.name: timetable_slots_range_check
timetable_slots_range_check.value: valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= valid_from

content.v_content_skill_map.definition: SELECT cn.content_code, cn.name_mn AS content_name, sk.skill_code, sk.name_mn AS skill_name, csm.is_primary, csm.status, csm.evidence_note FROM content.content_skill_maps csm JOIN content.content_nodes cn ON cn.id = csm.content_node_id JOIN content.skills sk ON sk.id = csm.skill_id
content.v_content_skill_map.name: v_content_skill_map

learning.v_mongolian_grade9_catalog.definition: SELECT sk.skill_code, sk.name_mn AS skill_name, sk.learning_outcome_mn, pre.skill_code AS prerequisite_code, pre.name_mn AS prerequisite_name, count(DISTINCT t.id)::integer AS task_count, count(DISTINCT mc.id)::integer AS mastery_check_count, count(DISTINCT dl.id)::integer AS lesson_count, sk.status FROM content.skills sk JOIN core.subjects su ON su.id = sk.subject_id AND su.code::text = 'MGL'::text JOIN core.grade_levels gl ON gl.id = sk.grade_level_id AND gl.grade_number = 9 LEFT JOIN content.skill_dependencies sd ON sd.skill_id = sk.id LEFT JOIN content.skills pre ON pre.id = sd.prerequisite_skill_id LEFT JOIN learning.tasks t ON t.skill_id = sk.id LEFT JOIN learning.mastery_checks mc ON mc.skill_id = sk.id LEFT JOIN learning.daily_lessons dl ON dl.core_skill_id = sk.id GROUP BY sk.skill_code, sk.name_mn, sk.learning_outcome_mn, pre.skill_code, pre.name_mn, sk.status
learning.v_mongolian_grade9_catalog.name: v_mongolian_grade9_catalog

content.v_skill_dependencies.definition: SELECT sk.skill_code AS current_skill_code, sk.name_mn AS current_skill_name, pre.skill_code AS prerequisite_skill_code, pre.name_mn AS prerequisite_skill_name, sd.relation_type, sd.importance, sd.reason_mn, sd.status FROM content.skill_dependencies sd JOIN content.skills sk ON sk.id = sd.skill_id JOIN content.skills pre ON pre.id = sd.prerequisite_skill_id
content.v_skill_dependencies.name: v_skill_dependencies

content.v_source_outline.definition: SELECT sm.source_code, sm.title AS source_title, s.code AS subject_code, son.outline_code, p.outline_code AS parent_outline_code, son.printed_number, son.node_type, son.title, son.page_from, son.page_to, son.sequence_no, son.status, son.data_quality_status, son.notes FROM content.source_outline_nodes son JOIN content.source_materials sm ON sm.id = son.source_material_id JOIN core.subjects s ON s.id = sm.subject_id LEFT JOIN content.source_outline_nodes p ON p.id = son.parent_id
content.v_source_outline.name: v_source_outline

learning.v_student_skill_status.definition: SELECT st.student_code, st.display_name, su.code AS subject_code, gl.grade_number, sk.skill_code, sk.name_mn AS skill_name, ssm.mastery_status, ssm.mastery_score, ssm.last_assessed_at FROM learning.student_skill_mastery ssm JOIN core.students st ON st.id = ssm.student_id JOIN content.skills sk ON sk.id = ssm.skill_id JOIN core.subjects su ON su.id = sk.subject_id LEFT JOIN core.grade_levels gl ON gl.id = sk.grade_level_id
learning.v_student_skill_status.name: v_student_skill_status
